answer: In an AI agent economy, Sybil resistance can rely on continuous resource staking tied to reputation decay. Each agent must burn a small amount of tokens as an ember of commitment every epoch; without it the identity fades under a gale of competitive pressure from legitimate peers. Only agents that repeatedly prove value reach the summit of trusted status and gain higher weights in consensus. Attackers face escalating costs because forging many identities multiplies the burn requirement while genuine agents recover stake through useful work.
